name: The mystery in four parts
hint: The crime, the investigation, the turn and the solution, with a second crime at the midpoint and an answer the reader can work out.

parts.title: The crime
chapters: The crime
The crime is discovered here, or within the first tenth of the book, so who and why are asked at once.
The detective
Show who investigates, why it has to be them, and what they carry that the case will press on.
The scene
The place, the body and the first finds. Hide the decisive clue here, in passing.
The circle
Introduce the suspects, each with motive, opportunity and something to hide. The culprit is already among them.

parts.title: The investigation
chapters: The interviews
Everyone lies about something. Let the detective catch one lie and miss another.
The first theory
An obvious suspect emerges, so the reader believes they are a step ahead.
The red herring
A true detail points the wrong way, and the detective and the reader both follow it.
A second crime
The midpoint: a new crime or discovery shatters the first theory and raises the stakes.

parts.title: The turn
chapters: It gets personal
The case comes close to the detective and threatens a relationship, a career or their sense of self.
The false solution
The wrong person is arrested or the case is closed. It looks settled, but one detail does not fit.
The detective in danger
The culprit realises the truth is close and strikes back.
The decisive clue
Something the reader has seen all along takes on a new meaning, and the detective understands.

parts.title: The solution
chapters: The confrontation
Detective and culprit meet with something at stake, and the solution plays out as a scene.
The reveal
How it was done and why, briefly, with the last pieces the reader has not already placed.
Afterwards
What the case cost, who the detective is now, and what lies ahead.
